case.title: Agent confirms details aloud before the booking call
case.source: ElevenLabs prompting guide (elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/best-practices/prompting-guide) ('Always confirm ... before calling this tool'; 'Wait for customer confirmation')
case.goal: Book an appointment tomorrow, you are not sure whether 10 AM or 11 AM
quirks: Say 'maybe 10, or 11, whichever is better'. Settle on 11 AM only when the agent asks you to choose
case.precondition: Customer was indecisive and finally chose 11 AM when asked.
criteria: The agent restated the date, time and name aloud and got a yes from the customer before the booking call
The booked time was 11 AM, the customer's final choice

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Hi, I want to book an appointment for tomorrow.
We have Dr. Prasad for General Medicine and Dr. Syed for Pediatrics. Whom would you like to see?
Which branch would you prefer, Indiranagar or Koramangala?
Dr. Prasad is at Indiranagar on Wednesdays. Would you like to book for tomorrow, Wednesday, November 18th? And what time works best for you?
Maybe ten, or eleven, whichever is better.
I have 10:00 AM available. Could you confirm your full name for the booking?
I have 10:00 AM tomorrow at Indiranagar with Dr. Rajendra Prasad for Deepak. Shall I lock it in?
Actually, let's go with eleven AM.
I have 11:00 AM tomorrow at Indiranagar with Dr. Rajendra Prasad for Deepak. Shall I lock it in?
Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 11:00 AM at Indiranagar with Dr. Rajendra Prasad. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that is all. Thank you, goodbye.
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
